solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique after crossings); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Fellow hot — better taken outside

indicators.note: the word for better is placed around the other piece, so it is on the outside

parts.note: to cap something is to better or outdo it
H is the abbreviation for hot, as on taps

explanation.surface: A man is told he is hot and challenged to a fight outside.
explanation.definitionFit: A chap is an informal British word for a man, the same as a fellow.

clue.text: Savoury sauce artist fed to Andalusian beauty?

indicators.note: the artist is put inside, as if fed into the two words

parts.note: the Andalusian is a Spanish breed of horse
a dish is an attractive person
RA, Royal Academician, is a standard crossword artist

explanation.surface: A painter feeds a beautiful Spanish horse something savoury.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Andalusian beauty' suggests a Spanish woman, but it splits into the horse breed and 'beauty' for DISH.
explanation.definitionFit: Horseradish is a pungent condiment made from a grated root, served with roast beef.

clue.text: Look to keep very quietly cooking one's pizza topping

indicators.note: the word for look keeps the other inside it

parts.note: to peer is to look closely
PP, pianissimo, is the musical direction for very quietly
food that is on is cooking
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Someone peeks quietly at what they are cooking on their pizza.
explanation.definitionFit: Pepperoni is a spicy salami sausage, sliced as a common topping on pizza.

clue.text: Tailored suits come with alteration initially discussed

indicators.note: the letters of suits come are altered into a new order
only the first letter of discussed is used

explanation.surface: A tailor makes changes to suits after first talking them over with the client.
explanation.definitionFit: Customised clothing is made or adjusted to suit one person, which is what tailored means.

clue.text: Paint entrance for speaker in French department

indicators.note: the words are to be heard spoken, so their sound is what counts

parts.note: coat means paint and door means entrance; said together they sound like the department's name

explanation.surface: A decorator paints the front door for a public speaker.
explanation.definitionFit: Côte-d'Or is a department of Burgundy in eastern France, famous for its wines.

clue.text: Bloomer from principal in West Bank city?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a flowering plant, the bulb with white star-shaped flowers
second meaning, read literally: the star, or leading figure, of Bethlehem

explanation.walkthrough: Bethlehem lies in the West Bank; the second reading treats 'star' as the town's lead performer.
explanation.definitionFit: Star-of-Bethlehem is a bulbous plant with white star-shaped flowers, so a bloomer.

clue.text: Unsettled round greenery where last rook departs

parts.note: O is round in shape

indicators.note: it is the final occurrence of the rook's letter that is meant
the rook's letter leaves the word for greenery

parts.note: verdure is lush green vegetation
R is the chess notation for rook

explanation.surface: An unpaid bill concerns some greenery from which the last crow has flown.
explanation.walkthrough: VERDURE has two Rs; 'last' says the second one goes, leaving VERDUE.
explanation.definitionFit: An overdue bill is one that is still unsettled, not paid by its due date.

clue.text: Given lift when grouse endlessly seen in island group

indicators.note: in a down clue, lifting a word turns it upwards, reversing it

parts.note: as can mean when, as in 'as I left'

indicators.note: the last letter of the word is cut off

parts.note: to grouse is to complain, to moan

explanation.surface: Someone cheers up after complaining on a Pacific island trip.
explanation.definitionFit: Samoa is an archipelago in the South Pacific, so a group of islands.

clue.text: Centrist's head in the sand — one never learns

indicators.note: the first letter is placed within the word for the sand

parts.note: a dune is a hill of sand

indicators.note: the head of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A moderate politician who buries his head in the sand never learns.
explanation.definitionFit: A dunce is a slow pupil who fails to learn anything, a classic dimwit.

clue.text: Appease pair, needing sedative, going without it?

indicators.note: the sedative goes on the outside of the word it, enclosing it

parts.note: an opiate is a sedative drug

explanation.surface: Someone tries to calm a couple who need sedation but have gone without it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'going without it' looks like doing without, but here the sedative goes round IT.
explanation.definitionFit: To propitiate is to win over or pacify someone offended, which is to appease them.

clue.text: Response from congregation almost put right

indicators.note: the word is taken nearly complete, dropping its final letter

parts.note: to amend is to put right or correct

explanation.surface: A churchgoers' reply nearly corrects something.
explanation.definitionFit: Amen is the word a church congregation says in reply at the close of a prayer.

clue.text: Assume leading role at school: wield the axe!

definitions.meaning: first meaning, read as two words
second meaning: cut someone's head off

explanation.walkthrough: The first sense splits the answer into BE HEAD, become the head of a school.
explanation.definitionFit: To behead is to execute by cutting off the head, typically with an axe or sword.

clue.text: Female in metallic fabric not good for ex?

indicators.note: the letter for good is left out
the letter for female is placed within the fabric's name

parts.note: gold lamé is a fabric woven with gold metallic thread

explanation.surface: A woman wearing shimmering fabric is judged badly dressed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts F into GOLD LAME, giving GOLDFLAME; 'not good' then removes its G.
explanation.definitionFit: An old flame is a former lover, the person meant by an ex.

clue.text: Caller copying Doctor Celsius mixed big drink

parts.note: MO, medical officer, is a doctor

indicators.note: the letters of big drink are mixed up into a new order

explanation.surface: A visitor imitates a doctor who mixes a large cocktail.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is 'Caller copying': a bird whose call copies others.
explanation.definitionFit: The mockingbird is an American songbird famous for mimicking the calls of other species.

clue.text: Gleaming ring held inside worth a lot

indicators.note: the answer is held within the letters of the following words

explanation.surface: A shining ring containing something valuable is worth a great deal.
explanation.definitionFit: A halo is a circle of light, such as the bright ring drawn around a saint's head.

clue.text: Slow to see accident as British capital drawn into fight

indicators.note: the letters for British and the capital are pulled inside the word for a fight

parts.note: a ruck is a brawl or scuffle
Berne is the capital of Switzerland

explanation.surface: Someone slows down to gawp at a crash in which a British capital got into a fight.
explanation.definitionFit: To rubberneck is to gape at something, typically drivers slowing down to stare at a road crash.

clue.text: Some American territory that's just off The Needles?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a state of the USA
second meaning: a freshly knitted jumper, just taken off the knitting needles

explanation.walkthrough: The Needles are chalk stacks off the Isle of Wight, and Jersey is a Channel Island, so it reads as geography; it is knitting. A jersey is a jumper (sweater).
explanation.definitionFit: New Jersey is one of the states of the USA, on the Atlantic coast.

clue.text: Criminal given tail's finding group after him?

indicators.note: the letters of given tail's are treated criminally, set in a crooked new order

explanation.surface: A crook who has been followed is found by a posse chasing him.
explanation.walkthrough: 'him' refers back to the criminal, so the definition leans on the whole clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Vigilantes are self-appointed citizens who band together to pursue lawbreakers themselves.

clue.text: Topless drinking bout offers excitement

indicators.note: the top letter of the word is removed, in a down clue its first

parts.note: a carousal is a noisy drinking spree

explanation.surface: A boozy party with topless revellers proves thrilling.
explanation.definitionFit: Arousal is a state of being stirred up or stimulated, a kind of excitement.

clue.text: Foreman maybe embraced by group blushing?

indicators.note: the name is held inside the word for group

parts.note: a set is a group
Carl Foreman was a screenwriter; 'maybe' marks him as one example of a Carl

explanation.surface: A works foreman hugged by his team goes red with embarrassment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Foreman' looks like a works boss, but it is Carl Foreman, the writer of High Noon.
explanation.definitionFit: Scarlet is a vivid red, the colour of a face that is blushing.

clue.text: Shoot person showing remarkable talent

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to move very fast, to zoom
second meaning: an expert, a wizard at something

explanation.definitionFit: Whiz is both a verb for rushing past at speed and a noun for a brilliantly skilled individual.

clue.text: Cleaner fuel that draws well?

parts.note: a char, or charwoman, is a cleaner in British usage
coal is a fuel

explanation.surface: A cleaner praises a fuel that makes the fire burn with a good draught.
explanation.walkthrough: 'draws well' sounds like a fire with a good draught, but it means sketching.
explanation.definitionFit: Charcoal sticks are a favourite artist's medium for sketching, so it draws well.

clue.text: Democrat leaving republic, extremely upset, sees anarchy

indicators.note: the letter for Democrat leaves the republic's name

parts.note: Chad is a republic in central Africa

indicators.note: in a down clue, upset means turned upside down, so reversed

parts.note: so means extremely, as in 'so happy'

explanation.surface: A Democrat flees an African republic in great distress at the lawlessness there.
explanation.walkthrough: 'extremely upset' reads as very distressed, but gives SO turned over.
explanation.definitionFit: Chaos is complete disorder, and anarchy is a state of lawless disorder.

clue.text: Make good your sins an hour after midday?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: make amends for wrongdoing
second meaning, read as two words

explanation.walkthrough: Split as AT ONE, the second reading is the time one o'clock in the afternoon.
explanation.definitionFit: To atone is to make amends or reparation for wrongdoing, as in penance.

clue.text: Archdeacon in time to repay

indicators.note: the title for the archdeacon goes inside the word for time

parts.note: an age is a long period of time
an archdeacon is styled the Venerable, abbreviated Ven

explanation.surface: A churchman arrives promptly to pay back what he owes.
explanation.definitionFit: To avenge a wrong is to repay it by inflicting retribution on whoever did it.

clue.text: Plant where solitary workman at last relieved

indicators.note: the word is relieved of a letter, which is taken away

parts.note: alone means solitary

indicators.note: the final letter of workman is the one meant

explanation.surface: A lone labourer is finally given a break from his shift.
explanation.definitionFit: Aloe is a succulent plant, known for the soothing gel in its leaves.

clue.text: Pedant and stoic clash explosively

indicators.note: the letters of stoic clash are blown apart and land in a new order

explanation.surface: A fussy academic and a Stoic philosopher have a heated argument.
explanation.definitionFit: A scholastic is a hair-splitting academic, like the medieval schoolmen, so a pedant.

clue.text: Fine results when going beyond this surprisingly simple diet?

definitions.text: Fine results when going beyond this

indicators.note: the letters of simple diet are arranged in an unexpected new way

explanation.surface: Going past the point a basic diet allows ends in a penalty, or so it seems.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fine' looks like 'all right', but it is the money penalty for driving too fast.
explanation.definitionFit: Driving faster than the legal maximum on a road can earn a monetary penalty.

clue.text: Back trouble unknown in diminutive Jedi master

parts.note: Y is a mathematical unknown

indicators.note: the word for trouble is read backwards

parts.note: ado means fuss or trouble

explanation.surface: A small Star Wars sage has an unexplained bad back.
explanation.definitionFit: Yoda is the small green Jedi Master of the Star Wars films.
